# Data and data sources

Everything needed to run the prototype is in this folder. Nothing here is proprietary or confidential, and
no S&P Global or Crisil data, names or engagement details are used.

## `sample/`: synthetic demo data (generated by `scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py`, seed 42)

| File | Rows | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `news_articles.csv` | 185 | Financial-news-style articles: `doc_id, source, outlet, published_at, title, body, url`. Outlets and URLs are placeholders. |
| `social_posts.csv` | 440 | X/Twitter-style posts: `post_id, source, platform, author, published_at, text, likes, reposts`. Handles are invented. |
| `prices_daily.csv` | 30 | Daily closes for the 15 index tickers (17 Aug – 25 Sep 2026). Synthetic: market and sector factors, noise, and the scripted news shocks. |
| `wholesale_trades.csv` | 140 | Trade-level booking records for a wholesale-banking book (loans, bonds, IRS, FX forwards, CDS, listed equity) with sector, region, currency, rating, PD, LGD, duration and convexity. All counterparties are fictional. |
| `scenario_ground_truth.csv` | 18 | The scripted events behind the stream (date, type, tickers, intended sentiment and impact). |

Tickers are real S&P 100 symbols so the mock index looks familiar. Every headline, post, price and trade is
invented, and fictional entities (Harbor Point Financial, CyberNova, Ridgeline Energy, all counterparties)
do not refer to real companies.

## `eval/`: labelled evaluation data (author-labelled, fictional companies)

| File | Rows | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `labeled_headlines.csv` | 118 | Dev set: used while tuning the lexicon and taxonomy, and to train the TF-IDF/LR model |
| `heldout_headlines.csv` | 60 | Held-out test set: written after tuning, never used for training or tuning |

## `lexicons/`: public word lists

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `lm_positive.txt`, `lm_negative.txt`, `lm_uncertainty.txt`, `lm_litigious.txt` | Loughran-McDonald Master Dictionary (Loughran & McDonald, 2011), https://sraf.nd.edu/loughranmcdonald-master-dictionary/ | Free for academic use |
| `huliu_positive.txt`, `huliu_negative.txt` | Opinion Lexicon (Hu & Liu, KDD 2004), https://www.cs.uic.edu/~liub/FBS/sentiment-analysis.html, via NLTK data | Free for research use |

## `output/`: engine outputs (regenerated by `python -m src.cli demo` and `python -m src.cli evaluate`)

`signals.jsonl` (every RiskSignal), `weights_history.csv` (Module A weights at each rebalance),
`index_performance.csv`, `stress_tests.json` (Module B results), `run_stats.json`, `evaluation.json`.
`signals.db` (SQLite) is created at run time and is not committed.

## Live sources (used by `python -m src.cli live`; nothing is stored in the repo)

| Source | Type | Access |
|---|---|---|
| NewsAPI (newsapi.org) | Financial news | Free developer key in env `NEWSAPI_KEY` |
| GDELT DOC 2.0 API | Global news | No key |
| Google News RSS | News headlines | No key |
| Reddit public JSON (r/stocks, r/investing, r/wallstreetbets) | Social media | No key |
| Yahoo Finance via `yfinance` | Daily prices | No key |
| Financial PhraseBank (HuggingFace `takala/financial_phrasebank`) | Optional sentiment benchmark | Downloaded on demand by `evaluate --phrasebank` |
